question: Should Wave 2+ modular dashboard work remain a bundled OpenClaw Control UI/Gateway roadmap, and which pieces should instead move to external plugin or ClawHub distribution?
rationale: The tracker proposes new product direction across persistent dashboard state, widget execution, publish/install flows, role-gated visibility, and security boundaries that cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor selected child work
options.body: Keep this tracker open and review the linked child issues and PRs one by one, requiring explicit storage, upgrade, and security proof before each merge.

options.title: Narrow to generic seams
options.body: Accept only the core/plugin API gaps maintainers want in OpenClaw and ask optional widget packs, skills, registries, or app bundles to ship outside core.

options.title: Defer bundled dashboards
options.body: Pause the roadmap if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboards are not current product work despite the existing plugin-tab seam.

recommendation.title: Sponsor selected child work
recommendation.body: Keep this tracker open and review the linked child issues and PRs one by one, requiring explicit storage, upgrade, and security proof before each merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Logbook/plugin-tab seam and related Control UI security boundary make this the strongest current-main ownership signal for the maintainer product choice.
